scope: Functional stakeholder mapping, not a statutory command hierarchy. Named institutions are source-attributed; individual leaders should be checked against official rosters before publication.

minerals.title: Minerals Institutional & Stakeholder Mapping
minerals.subtitle: Six functional accountability systems. Regulator, shareholder, industrial authority and operator are distinct.

branches.name: Mineral Regulators
branches.description: Mining policy, licensing, approved work programmes and supervisory functions.

actors.name: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM)
actors.role: National mining-sector policy and mineral-resource governance.
actors.detail: Sets the mineral policy framework; it is not the commercial owner of every operator.

actors.name: Directorate General of Minerals and Coal (Ditjen Minerba)
actors.role: Sectoral permitting administration, production oversight and RKAB-related supervision.
actors.detail: Differentiate permit/production supervision from company mine operations.

actors.name: Policy & Risk Register
actors.role: Legal text, revisions, effective dates and implementing rules are tracked in the central register.
actors.detail: Use SLI Policy & Risk for authoritative policy status.

branches.name: Industrial & Investment
branches.description: Downstream industrial policy and investment facilitation.

actors.name: Ministry of Industry (Kemenperin)
actors.role: Industrial development, refining/smelting policy and manufacturing-chain oversight.
actors.detail: Industrial policy is separate from mineral extraction licensing.

actors.name: Ministry of Investment / BKPM
actors.role: Investment facilitation, recorded PMA/PMDN realization and business licensing procedures.
actors.detail: Aggregate investment numbers are not proof of entity-level capex.

actors.name: Environmental regulatory authorities
actors.role: Environmental approval, safeguards and compliance according to prevailing jurisdiction.
actors.detail: Confirm permit authority and environmental approval for each site.

branches.name: State Ownership
branches.description: Equity and state-linked corporate operating portfolios.

actors.name: MIND ID
actors.role: State-owned mining industry holding and investment portfolio.
actors.detail: Ownership rights differ from ESDM policy powers.

actors.name: PT ANTAM Tbk
actors.role: Commercial mineral extraction, refining and downstream investment activities.
actors.detail: Specific project ownership and JV percentages require primary company records.

actors.name: State-linked mining subsidiaries
actors.role: Operating companies and shareholding entities within disclosed government-linked portfolios.
actors.detail: Do not imply direct operational control by every ministry.

branches.name: Private & JV Operators
branches.description: Private and mixed-ownership asset operators and project SPVs.

actors.name: PT Freeport Indonesia
actors.role: Copper mining and downstream smelter operations.
actors.detail: Verify project stage, ownership chain and measured copper throughput separately.

actors.name: Nickel industrial partnerships / SPVs
actors.role: Nickel mine, NPI/ferronickel, HPAL, MHP and battery-material facilities.
actors.detail: SPV legal name, shareholders and license perimeter vary by campus.

actors.name: PT Borneo Alumina Indonesia
actors.role: Alumina refinery project company linked to Indonesia's bauxite processing value chain.
actors.detail: Alumina tonnage is not aluminium-metal tonnage.

branches.name: Parliament & Audit
branches.description: External scrutiny and public financial accountability.

actors.name: DPR RI sectoral commissions
actors.role: Legislative oversight of relevant mining, industry and environmental responsibilities.
actors.detail: Committee assignments should be verified against the active parliamentary roster.

actors.name: BPK RI
actors.role: State financial audit for entities within its legal audit jurisdiction.
actors.detail: Audit findings are not automatic conclusions about individual projects.

branches.name: Regional Delivery
branches.description: Permitting interfaces, local infrastructure and operational effects.

actors.name: Provincial and district governments
actors.role: Land, local planning, infrastructure interface and community/public service responsibilities.
actors.detail: Competence depends on the legal instrument and territorial jurisdiction.

actors.name: Grid utilities & infrastructure providers
actors.role: Power, water, transport and logistics services for energy-intensive mineral facilities.
actors.detail: Availability and tariffs vary by project.

actors.name: Research and technical institutes
actors.role: Standards, applied mineral R&D and workforce development.
actors.detail: Policy input does not imply regulatory authority.

ai.title: AI & Data Center Institutional Mapping
ai.subtitle: Six functional systems, from public policy to power, operators and local delivery. Cloud services are not equivalent to verified AI GPU capacity.

branches.name: Digital & AI Policy
branches.description: National digital policy and AI ecosystem coordination.

actors.name: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi)
actors.role: Digital ecosystem, infrastructure policy and coordination of AI governance.
actors.detail: Distinguish draft roadmap and ethics regulation from enacted instruments.

actors.name: Digital ecosystem directorates
actors.role: AI ecosystem programmes and cross-government coordination within Komdigi's active organizational structure.
actors.detail: Directorate and incumbent names require current official roster verification.

actors.name: Policy & Risk Register
actors.role: Authoritative source/status mapping for PDP, electronic systems and AI governance.
actors.detail: Draft ≠ enacted; do not duplicate legal instrument text here.

branches.name: Power & Connectivity
branches.description: Electrical delivery and network access to commercial facilities.

actors.name: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM)
actors.role: Power-sector regulation and energy infrastructure policy.
actors.detail: Grid allocation is not commissioned IT load.

actors.name: PT PLN (Persero)
actors.role: Grid connection, electricity supply contracts and infrastructure delivery.
actors.detail: MVA, facility MW, IT MW and delivered capacity are different measures.

actors.name: Telecommunications / fiber carriers
actors.role: Terrestrial backbone and submarine connectivity to data centers.
actors.detail: Verify route diversity, availability and operator by facility.

branches.name: Capital & State Portfolio
branches.description: Investment facilitation and corporate ownership must be distinguished.

actors.name: Ministry of Investment / BKPM
actors.role: Recorded PMA and PMDN realization, facilitation and project support.
actors.detail: National investment totals cannot isolate AI-data-center spending.

actors.name: Telkom Group / data-center businesses
actors.role: Commercial participation in cloud, connectivity and colocation through identified subsidiaries.
actors.detail: Telkom subsidiaries are not the regulator of every data center.

actors.name: Danantara / state-capital participants
actors.role: State portfolio and investment participation where documented in identified legal entities.
actors.detail: Do not imply the state owns or operates all private data centers.

actors.name: National Cyber and Crypto Agency (BSSN)
actors.role: Cybersecurity coordination and national cyber-resilience functions.
actors.detail: Cybersecurity agency is not the operator of private security operations centers.

actors.name: Personal data protection governance
actors.role: Legal responsibilities under Indonesian PDP legislation and implementing institutions.
actors.detail: State the effective law and confirm regulator formation separately.

actors.name: Commercial security operators
actors.role: Data-center and cloud security operations, incident response and risk controls.
actors.detail: Implementation varies by entity and contract.

branches.name: Cloud & Site Operators
branches.description: Companies that finance, build, host, or sell infrastructure services.

actors.name: Digital Edge
actors.role: Colocation/data-center development including CGK and Jakarta facilities.
actors.detail: Separate prospective MW from operating facility IT MW.

actors.name: Microsoft
actors.role: Indonesia Central commercial cloud services and investment commitments.
actors.detail: Cloud region live ≠ published national AI GPU inventory.

actors.name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
actors.role: Asia Pacific (Jakarta) cloud-region services.
actors.detail: Cloud-region operating status does not specify site-specific GPU capacity.

branches.name: Regions, R&D & Skills
branches.description: Site-level jurisdictions and domestic compute capability.

actors.name: Greater Jakarta / West Java authorities
actors.role: Regional planning, permits and physical industrial-site interfaces.
actors.detail: Site coordinates, power and land permits must be matched to facility.

actors.name: Batam regional authorities / BP Batam
actors.role: Industrial-zone facilitation, border connectivity and local delivery.
actors.detail: Batam's Singapore proximity is not proof of commissioned cross-border service.

actors.name: BRIN, universities and polytechnics
actors.role: AI research, technical skills and access to domestic computing resources.
actors.detail: Track practical training and compute access, not only signed MoUs.
